question: State the area and climate described for Aruba; name the countries bordering Andorra.
raw:
O1: [S2] Aruba has an area of 179 square kilometres (69.1 sq mi) and has a dry climate with an arid xeric landscape.  
O2: [S4] The countries bordering Andorra are France to the north and Spain to the south.
